description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml' that extends XMLWriter to convert HTMLPurifier configuration schemas into an XML format for documentation purposes. It contains methods to build XML documents based on a given interchange object representing configuration directives.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml
classes.description: A class responsible for converting a configuration schema interchange object into an XML representation, for documentation purposes.

methods.name: writeHTMLDiv
methods.description: sanitizes HTML input and writes it inside a <div> element within the XML document.

methods.name: export
methods.description: exports variables to string representation, handling empty array case.

methods.name: build
methods.description: initializes XML document and starts building XML structure based on the interchange object.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: builds XML elements for a configuration directive, including namespace, aliases, constraints, description, and deprecation info.
